outcome: Approximate entropy (ApEn) of fetal heart rate
Sample entropy (SampEn) of fetal heart rate
cohort: Pregnant women with recorded fetal heart rate (FHR) data during labor (280 recordings in the second stage of labor, 31 in the first stage, and 23 in pre-labor)
finding: Entropy indices of fetal heart rate, ApEn and SampEn, were significantly different according to labor progression, being lowest in the second stage.
mod_finding: Entropy indices of FHR were significantly lower in the second stage of labor compared to the first stage and pre-labor, suggesting a potential role for these indices in intrapartum fetal monitoring.
